technology_name: Chitosan-Based Polymeric Wound Dressing for Chronic and Infected Wounds
institution: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST)
problem_solved: Management of chronic non-healing and infected wounds.
description: The chitosan-based polymeric wound dressing is designed for chronic non-healing and infected wounds. The sponge-like dressing enables controlled delivery of antimicrobial drugs directly to the wound site. The drug can be loaded by the doctor as per the need by a simple mechanism.
applications:
Hospitals, wound care centers, and specialty healthcare facilities
Medical device and advanced wound dressing manufacturers
Pharmaceutical companies developing wound management solutions
Home healthcare and chronic care service providers
Defence medical services, trauma care units, and rehabilitation centers
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Advanced Materials & Chemicals, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
